title: mine pump (sheared)

sections.heading: Current state
sections.text: The pump's rod has sheared at the collar, and the old binding hangs in black strings. Water stands in the shaft below. You carry what it takes to mend it for good.

sections.heading: How to use
sections.text:
Stand beside it, press C and choose mend the mine pump for good, or patch it for now. The menu lists each material with how many you carry.
Needs: to mend it for good: 2 iron spike, 1 oak haft, 1 leather binding; to patch it for now: 2 fire clay.
Cost and limits: Mending uses up the materials and keeps any tool, and the repair lasts. A patch holds about 600 turns, then fails.
Right now you can: mend the mine pump for good. Not now: patch the mine pump for now (You still need 1 more fire clay).

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A hand pump on an iron collar over the mine shaft, worked by a long oak rod. The lower level lives or drowns by it.
